name: SMD Rise Public Company Limited
summary: SMD Rise Public Company Limited, established in 1998 and headquartered in Nonthaburi, Thailand, focuses on the import and supply of a wide range of medical devices, equipment, and associated supplies. The company serves the Thai healthcare sector, including private hospitals, clinics, and the general public. In addition to product distribution, SMD Rise offers various services such as sleep diagnostic testing, as well as providing flexible medical equipment acquisition solutions through rental, hire purchase, and leasing arrangements. The company also extends its services to include wellness equipment. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses radiology-related items and other comparable medical products. It is important to note that the entity currently known as SaintMed Public Company Limited will officially change its name to SMD Rise Public Company Limited in January 2025.
